title: INshop
blurb: Design your store, arcade or space in 3D: draw walls, cut doors and windows, drop in arcade cabinets, a curved bar, shelves, neon signs and your own 3D models and images, then walk through it on screen or in VR. Starts with the Mother Barbs underground arcade.
controls: Add tab: click an item, then click the floor to place it. Drag to move, R rotates, W draws walls, Ctrl+Z undoes. Plan for top view, Walk for first person (WASD). Enter VR on a headset: trigger to teleport, left stick walks, right stick turns.
